title: Same profile, net debt at 3.9x EBITDA

input.facts: Hospital EHR platform with multi-year subscription contracts; recurring revenue is 72% of sales. Net debt is 3.9x EBITDA after a funded acquisition. The share price fell 28% on a delayed product release, now shipped. No holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: 3.9x is below the 4x kill line, and the criteria are met: Priority.
